about: The arrivals of dbg tp in the expansions (DBG-TP-EXPANSION-ARRIVALS-66, docs/AMIWIND_CONSOLE_COMMANDS.md): each place's console names, its expansion, and where the original itself puts the player there (a script's PositionCell, a travel service's destination, where a door puts the player). A place in a room gives its cell and the position in that cell's own units with the facing in degrees; an outdoor place gives the position in the original's global units. The image step writes them into the image's teleport-names.txt (tools/expansion_arrivals.py): a working destination when the build selected the expansion and the image holds the place, else a row that says so and does not move the player. A place marked hop is visited by the smoke hops whenever the image holds it. Mournhold's five districts are written as not in this build until their presentation as outdoor cells exists; their rows keep the place by cell name, so that presentation only has to say where each cell lies.
